name: Yeshaq I
contribution: Emperor of Ethiopia from 1414 to 1429/1430, and a member of the Solomonic dynasty.

checks.lead: Yeshaq I (Ge'ez: ይሥሐቅ), throne name: Gabra Masqal II (Ge'ez: ገብረ መስቀል) was Emperor of Ethiopia from 1414 to 1429/1430, and a member of the Solomonic dynasty. He was the second son of Emperor Dawit I.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
